page.title: Alder, a neobank built on Didit
page.lede: Open an account, verify your identity and move money. Every step runs on Didit's real API: KYC and AML at sign-up, transaction monitoring on every payment, ongoing AML screening after that.

unavailable.title: This demo runs on Didit staging
unavailable.body: Opening an account here runs real identity verification and AML screening for the Didit demo organization, so the demo is served from the staging environment.

common.error: Something went wrong talking to Didit. Try again in a moment.
common.unavailable: This demo is not available on this deployment.

welcome.title: A current account that opens in minutes
welcome.body: An IBAN in your name, instant transfers across Europe and no monthly fee.

points.verify: Verify with your ID and a selfie
points.send: Send and receive money straight away

welcome.note: Use your own ID: the data goes to Didit's staging environment only, never to a real bank.

signup.title: Tell us about you
signup.body: We use this to open your account. You confirm it with your ID in the next step.
signup.name: Full name
signup.namePlaceholder: As it appears on your ID
signup.consent: By continuing you agree that Alder shares your details with Didit to verify your identity.

errors.name: Enter your full name.
errors.country: Choose the country you live in.

verify.title: Verify your identity
verify.body: We are required to confirm who you are before we open your account. It takes about two minutes.

steps.face: We match your selfie to your ID
steps.aml: We screen your name against sanctions and PEP lists

verify.phone: No camera here? The verification shows a QR code to finish on your phone.
verify.cancelled: You closed the verification before finishing. Your progress is saved, so you can continue where you left off.

checking.title: Checking your details
checking.body: This usually takes less than a minute. Keep this page open.
checking.slow: This is taking longer than usual. We keep checking in the background.

approved.title: Your account is open
approved.body: Welcome to Alder, {name}. Your account is ready: add money and start using it.

review.title: We are reviewing your application
review.body: We need a little more time to confirm some details. Most reviews finish within one working day, and we will email {email} as soon as we are done.
review.live: This page updates by itself when the review ends.

declined.title: We could not open your account
declined.body: We were not able to verify your identity, so we cannot open an account for you right now.

expired.title: Your verification expired
expired.body: The verification link is no longer valid. Start again to open your account.

home.emptyBody: Add money first, then send some. Transfers of {threshold} or more are checked before they leave your account.
home.limit: You reached the demo limit of {limit} payments. Start over to open a new account.

pay.depositBody: From your account at another bank, in your own name.
pay.transferBody: To anyone with a bank account in Europe.
pay.reviewHint: Transfers of {threshold} or more are held for a quick check before they leave.
pay.willReview: This transfer will be checked before it leaves.

errors.limit: You reached the demo limit of payments for this account.

received.title: {amount} added
received.body: The money is in your account and ready to use.

held.title: Your payment is on hold
held.body: We are running a quick check on this payment before it leaves your account. The money is set aside until then, and this screen updates as soon as the check ends.

declined.title: Payment declined
declined.body: This payment did not go through and no money left your account.

action.title: We need something from you
action.body: Confirm your identity to release this payment.

monitoring.title: Ongoing AML monitoring
monitoring.body: After you join, your profile is rescreened every day against sanctions, PEP and adverse-media lists. A new listing reaches our compliance team without asking you to verify again.
monitoring.note: Estimate only: nothing was switched on, screened or billed.

panel.title: How this uses Didit
panel.subtitle: The modules and API calls behind each step, live on staging.

signup.title: Sign up
signup.body: The bank's own form. The customer id it creates is sent to Didit as vendor_data, the key that ties every session, payment and screening to this person.

verify.title: Identity verification
verify.body: One hosted session runs the bank's workflow: ID verification, active liveness, face match 1:1, AML screening and IP analysis.

decision.title: Decision
decision.body: The session status decides the account: Approved opens it, In Review waits for an analyst, Declined keeps it closed. The customer never sees why.

payments.title: Transaction monitoring
payments.body: Every payment is posted with the same vendor_data. The rules run synchronously and the verdict comes back in the response.

review.title: Review
review.body: Transfers of {threshold} or more match the rule "{rule}" and wait for an analyst in the console. The app re-reads the payment and updates when they decide.

monitoring.title: Ongoing AML monitoring
monitoring.body: Switches on daily rescreening for verified customers. The demo asks only for the estimate, which writes nothing.

operator.title: Operator view
operator.body: What the bank's compliance team sees for this customer in the Didit console.
operator.empty: Nothing yet. Records appear here as you go through the app.
operator.login: Needs a console login for the Didit demo organization.
